questions.question: Explain Audio Documentary, Docudrama and Audio Drama as podcast formats. Discuss how narration, dialogue, sound and storytelling are used in these formats. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Audio Documentary: presents factual information & uses narration, interviews, archival
  • recordings, and actuality sounds. Narration provides context, while authentic voices and
  • environmental sounds establish credibility and realism. Storytelling organises facts into a
  • coherent and engaging account.
  • Docudrama: combines factual material with dramatic reconstruction. Narration supplies
  • background information, dialogue recreates conversations, and sound establishes atmosphere.
  • This format makes factual subjects emotionally engaging while requiring a distinction between
  • documented facts and dramatized elements.
  • Audio Drama: fictional storytelling format created primarily through sound. It uses dialogue,
  • character voices, sound effects, music, and silence to establish settings, develop characters, and
  • advance the plot. Narration may introduce scenes or explain events, although some dramas rely
  • entirely on dialogue and sound. [U] / [CO1]

questions.question: Discuss the principles of plot construction in screenwriting with reference to causality, conflict, reversals and dramatic progression. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Plot: strategic selection & arrangement of events for maximum emotional & dramatic effect.
  • Causality: relationship between events, in which one action produces a consequence that
  • influences subsequent events – May be weak or strong
  • Conflict: the central force driving a story forward. It may be internal, interpersonal, social, or
  • environmental.
  • Reversal: shifts plot direction dramatically. Types: fortune changes, new knowledge, dramatic
  • change of location, power shift
  • Dramatic progression: the gradual development of tension and stakes. A screenplay typically
  • follows an exposition, rising action, climax, and resolution.
  • Causality ensures coherence, conflict provides dramatic energy, reversals maintain
  • unpredictability, and progression guides the audience towards a satisfying resolution.
  • Successful plot construction balances surprise with plausibility. [U] / [CO2]

questions.question: “Text, sound, music, silence and voice are not merely technical elements of digital media; they actively contribute to the creation of meaning and narrative.” Validate this statement with reference to the role of these elements in digital media. / [CO3] [15x2 = 30]
questions.solution_html:
• Digital media communication is an interaction of verbal, auditory, and visual elements.
  • Text communicates information directly through captions, headlines, subtitles, scripts, and
  • on-screen messages. In digital storytelling, text can provide context, establish themes, and
  • guide interpretation. Sound creates a sense of space and realism, establish settings, indicate
  • action, create suspense, and suggest events that are not visually represented. Music
  • establishes mood and tone, connects scenes, reinforces themes, and influences audience
  • responses. Silence or pause indicates hesitation, grief, uncertainty, or anticipation. The
  • absence of sound can intensify emotions and draw attention to significant moments. V oice
  • conveys information while expressing personality, emotion, authority, and cultural identity.
  • Thus, digital media derives its narrative power from the meaningful combination of the above
  • elements, enabling complex ideas and memorable audience experiences. [U] / [CO3]
